meta.name: cyberedge-discover-services
meta.description: Run controlled TCP connect service discovery through the CyberEdge Agent Protocol for an explicitly authorized Scope. Use when an AI agent must identify exposed baseline services on approved domain or IP targets; never use for ambiguous targets, vulnerability exploitation, arbitrary port ranges, or targets without a human-provided authorization reference.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描授权目标上的开放服务端口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对授权目标进行服务发现扫描
copy.tagline_en: Scan authorized targets for open service ports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to perform service discovery on authorized targets

howto.what: 装好后，Claude可以运行受控的TCP连接扫描，识别已授权目标上暴露的基础服务，并返回开放端口列表和服务提示（非产品名）。
howto.when: 当用户明确提供一个已授权的域名或IP范围，并请求扫描其开放服务时触发。

say.text: 检查这个IP上运行了哪些TCP服务。
say.note: 扫描后返回端口和提示。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can run controlled TCP connect service discovery on authorized targets, returning open ports and service hints (not product identities).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides an explicitly authorized domain or IP range and asks to scan for exposed services.

say_en.text: Check which TCP services are running on this IP.
say_en.note: Returns ports and service hints after scan.
